Job Description:         Who We Are   Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know diverse backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you.        US Citizenship Required       Clearance Required: Secret       Flexible Hybrid Role with requirement to work onsite at customer location as required      Job Description   Join a team operating secure, mission-critical private-cloud infrastructure where network availability, resilience, and security directly support essential customer operations. This is a hands-on opportunity to solve complex engineering challenges, strengthen a highly regulated environment, and help shape how advanced cloud and network services are operated at scale.  You will bring strong Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking fundamentals, experience in secure data centers and Disconnected Cloud Environments, disciplined ITSM execution, clear documentation, and confident ownership in customer-facing situations.    What You’ll Do    Operate and troubleshoot LAN, WAN, datacenter, and disconnected-cloud networks across classified and non-classified environments, including switches, routers, firewalls, load balancers, VPNs, DNS/IPAM, and network-management platforms.  Resolve complex connectivity, routing, policy, performance, and application-delivery issues using packet capture, monitoring, logs, and structured troubleshooting.  Execute approved network and security changes through ServiceNow, including firewall policies, access controls, load-balancing profiles, routing, and DNS updates, while maintaining incident, request, problem, and knowledge records.  Support and troubleshoot VMware NSX tenant networking and secure private-cloud connectivity, including tenant segments, routing, security policies, and infrastructure-to-cloud integration.  Partner with cloud, virtualization, systems, security, architecture, and application teams on tenant onboarding, workload migrations, technology refreshes, continuity exercises, disaster recovery, and production deployments.  Translate approved architecture into diagrams, low-level designs, implementation and test plans, operating procedures, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge-transfer materials for out-of-band connectivity, IPsec, NAT, segmentation, and customer integration.  Monitor service health, identify recurring risks, and improve reliability through automation, standardization, knowledge sharing, and disciplined problem management.  Lead customer and cross-functional technical discussions, communicate status, risks, dependencies, and recovery actions, identify ownership or architecture gaps, and drive resolution through engineering, security, and governance channels.  Review network and NSX STIG checklists, document findings, implement approved hardening, and maintain audit-ready evidence through change management.  Participate in an on-call rotation and provide evening or weekend support when mission requirements demand it.     Required Qualifications    U.S. citizenship and an active DoD Secret clearance are required at application. Candidates must be able to maintain the clearance and obtain customer-specific access.  DoD 8140-compliant baseline certification, such as CompTIA Security+ or an approved higher-level certification, required upon start.  Bachelor’s degree in computer science, network engineering, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant technical experience.  Seven or more years of progressive network engineering or operations experience, including hands-on responsibility for complex enterprise, Datacenter, private-cloud, or federal environments.     Technical Skills:    Experience configuring and troubleshooting Layer 2/3 networking, TCP/IP, VLANs, ACLs, DNS, DHCP, NAT, VPNs, BGP, and OSPF. Experience supporting SDN or VMware NSX environments, including tenant connectivity, segmentation, routing, and security-policy troubleshooting.  Hands-on experience with enterprise switches, routers, firewalls, load balancers, DNS/IPAM, monitoring, and packet-analysis platforms. Experience with Juniper, Palo Alto, Infoblox, OpsRamp, NetScout, Splunk, Wireshark, or comparable technologies is highly valued.  Experience with secure or regulated infrastructure, including Zero Trust, hardening, STIG/SRG implementation, CKL review, vulnerability remediation, Tenable or ACAS validation, segmentation, access control, evidence collection, and RMF/ATO documentation.  Strong communication and judgment, with the ability to work independently through ServiceNow-based incident, request, change, problem, knowledge, CMDB, CAB, and escalation processes while collaborating with customers and engineering teams.     Preferred Qualifications    Experience supporting Department of Defense or other federal mission environments, including classified and non-classified networks, disconnected or air-gapped operations, Government-Furnished Equipment access, and controlled transfer or sanitization of operational data and evidence.  Experience with SCCA, disconnected or air-gapped private cloud, hybrid-cloud connectivity, tenant onboarding, multi-tenant routing and segmentation, and integration with platforms such as ServiceNow, OpsRamp, Elastic, Tenable, Cohesity, Morpheus, and identity services.  Advanced experience with VMware NSX-T and Juniper routing and switching. Experience with Palo Alto, Infoblox or BlueCat DDI, Cisco or Aruba, VRFs, EVPN/VXLAN, IPv4/IPv6, IPsec, policy-based routing, and high-availability design is preferred.  Familiarity with network automation, configuration validation, and repeatable workflows using Ansible, Python, PowerShell, Bash, Terraform, APIs, version control, or similar tools.  Working knowledge of VMware, Windows Server, Active Directory, PKI, Linux/UNIX, and related infrastructure technologies.  AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner, relevant network-vendor certification, cloud certification, or advanced cybersecurity credential.  Experience leading technical troubleshooting sessions, mentoring engineers, creating training content, or coordinating work across mission partners.     Success in This Role    Maintains reliable, secure network services and restores service quickly when incidents occur.  Executes production changes accurately, communicates risk early, and leaves clear operational documentation behind.  Connects network operations to the broader cloud service and works effectively across organizational boundaries.  Builds customer confidence through technical credibility, ownership, responsiveness, and follow-through.  Improves the environment over time through standardization, automation, knowledge sharing, and disciplined problem management.     Work Requirements    Flexible hybrid role with onsite work at a designated federal customer or HPE location as mission needs require.  Work primarily Monday through Friday during standard business hours, with flexibility for evening, weekend, maintenance-window, and rotational support.  Ability and willingness to travel when required.  Ability to work effectively across diverse teams and manage changing priorities in a mission-focused technical environment.  mechanisms  that manage safe and trustworthy execution.     You will partner with engineering, product, legal/privacy, and security leadership to turn fast-moving agentic AI     capabilities     into title: Channel Presales Technical Architect /  Architecte technique avant-vente pour les partenaires
description_html: Channel Presales Technical Architect /  Architecte technique avant-vente pour les partenaires          This role has been designated as ‘Remote/Teleworker’, which means you will primarily work from home.                    Who We Are:                               Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.                     Job Description:        HPE is looking for a Channel Presales Technical Architect to grow technical advocacy for HPE storage solutions across our partner community. You'll be the trusted technical advisor to our top channel partners. You'll help their teams position, design and deliver HPE storage and data protection solutions for their customers, and turn that partner capability into pipeline and revenue growth.  This role combines deep storage architecture expertise with partner enablement. You'll work alongside partner sellers and engineers on live opportunities, and you'll also build their long-term ability to lead with HPE on their own.       What you'll do       Partner technical advocacy and enablement   Build strong, lasting relationships with partner technical and sales teams, and become their go-to resource for HPE storage.    Grow the number of partner engineers who can confidently position, demo and design HPE storage solutions, through enablement sessions, workshops, whiteboarding and hands-on labs.    Identify and develop technical champions within partner organizations, and support their progress through HPE certifications and partner program requirements.    Represent HPE at partner events, tech days and customer-facing briefings.      Solution architecture and opportunity support   Join deep-dive discussions with partners and end customers to understand technical needs and assess current IT infrastructure. Translate those needs into an architected solution, including technical alternatives and potential gaps.    Deliver compelling presentations and demos that tie HPE's technical capabilities to tangible business outcomes for partners and their customers.    Support solution configurations and proofs of concept (PoCs) that meet partner and end-customer requirements.    Develop competitive strategies with partners to win against competing vendors.      Pipeline and growth   Work with HPE account teams, channel managers and partners to generate, qualify and progress storage opportunities.    Protect and expand HPE's footprint through the partner community by driving new technology adoption, upgrades and refreshes across the installed base.    Keep pipeline information accurate and current for your partners so every deal is nurtured and moves toward close.    Ensure a smooth handoff from sale to implementation by orienting partners and internal teams to the solution design and identifying training needs.        What you bring       Education and experience   Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.    5+ years of technical presales experience with a major storage vendor or storage-focused channel partner.    Deep hands-on expertise in pitching, demoing and architecting complex storage solutions.    Demonstrated knowledge of virtualization, including VMware or KVM-based environments, and at least two application stacks (such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle or SAP).    Hands-on working knowledge of at least one major public cloud (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud); certifications preferred.    Expertise across the full data lifecycle: block, file, backup, ransomware protection and related solutions.    Deep competitive knowledge of at least one major storage vendor.    Expertise in at least one major vertical (financial services, manufacturing or healthcare) and its related solutions is preferred.      Knowledge and skills   Strong knowledge of channel partner business models and offerings, with proven ability to engage, collaborate with and technically enable partners throughout the sales cycle.    Excellent consultative selling skills, including active listening, framing, whiteboarding and storytelling.    Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable presenting to technical teams and business executives alike.    Strong knowledge of storage industry trends, competitor products and strategies.    Strong business and financial acumen, with an understanding of the roles and priorities of different customer stakeholders.    Solid project management, analytical and problem-solving skills.    Familiarity with CRM systems and sales tools, and comfort using social media and other channels to share technical content.    Storage-related industry certifications strongly preferred.         Architecte technique avant-vente pour les partenaires     HPE recherche un architecte technique avant-vente pour les partenaires afin de développer la promotion technique des solutions de stockage HPE auprès de notre réseau de partenaires. Vous serez le conseiller technique de confiance de nos principaux partenaires. Vous aiderez leurs équipes à positionner, concevoir et déployer des solutions de stockage et de protection des données HPE pour leurs clients, et à transformer cette expertise en croissance du chiffre d'affaires et du pipeline commercial.     Ce poste combine une solide expertise en architecture de stockage et un rôle clé dans l'accompagnement des partenaires. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes commerciales et techniques des partenaires sur des projets concrets et vous contribuerez à développer leur capacité à piloter les solutions HPE de manière autonome.      Vos tâches      Promotion technique et accompagnement des partenaires     • Établir des relations solides et durables avec les équipes techniques et commerciales des partenaires et devenir leur personne-ressource pour le stockage HPE.     • Développer le nombre d'ingénieurs partenaires capables de positionner, de présenter et de concevoir avec assurance des solutions de stockage HPE, grâce à des séances de formation, des ateliers, des séances de remue-méninges et des travaux pratiques.     • Identifier et développer les référents techniques au sein des organisations partenaires et les accompagner dans leur progression à travers les certifications HPE et les exigences du programme partenaire. • Représenter HPE lors d'événements partenaires, de journées techniques et de réunions de clients.     Architecture de solutions et accompagnement des opportunités     • Participer à des discussions approfondies avec les partenaires et les clients finaux afin de comprendre leurs besoins techniques et d'évaluer leur infrastructure informatique actuelle. Traduire ces besoins en une solution architecturée, incluant les alternatives techniques et les lacunes potentielles.     • Faire des présentations et des démonstrations percutantes illustrant les capacités techniques de HPE et leurs résultats commerciaux concrets pour les partenaires et leurs clients.     • Accompagner la configuration des solutions et la réalisation de preuves de concept (PoC) répondant aux exigences des partenaires et des clients finaux.     • Élaborer des stratégies concurrentielles avec les partenaires pour se démarquer de la concurrence.     Gestion du pipeline et croissance     • Collaborer avec les équipes de vente HPE, les gestionnaires de canaux et les partenaires pour identifier, qualifier et faire progresser les possibilités de stockage.     • Protéger et développer la présence de HPE auprès du réseau de partenaires en favorisant l'adoption de nouvelles technologies, les mises à niveau et les renouvellements au sein de la base installée.     • Maintenir à jour les informations relatives au pipeline pour vos partenaires afin d'accompagner chaque opportunité jusqu'à sa conclusion. • Assurer une transition fluide entre la vente et la mise en œuvre en familiarisant les partenaires et les équipes internes avec la conception de la solution et en identifiant les besoins de formation.      Votre profil      Formation et expérience     • Baccalauréat en génie, informatique ou domaine technique connexe, ou expérience pratique équivalente.     • Plus de 5 ans d'expérience en avant-vente technique auprès d'un grand fournisseur de solutions de stockage ou d'un partenaire spécialisé dans le stockage.     • Solide expertise pratique en matière de présentation, de démonstration et d'architecture de solutions de stockage complexes.     • Connaissance avérée de la virtualisation, notamment des environnements VMware ou KVM, et d'au moins deux plateformes applicatives (telles que Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle ou SAP).     • Maîtrise pratique d'au moins un opérateur infonuagique public majeur (AWS, Azure ou Google Cloud) ; les certifications sont un atout.     • Expertise couvrant l'ensemble du cycle de vie des données : stockage en bloc, fichier, sauvegarde, protection contre les rançongiciels et solutions associées.     • Excellente connaissance concurrentielle d'au moins un grand fournisseur de solutions de stockage.     • Une expertise dans au moins un secteur vertical majeur (services financiers, industrie ou santé) et ses solutions associées est un atout.     Connaissances et compétences     • Excellente connaissance des modèles d'affaires et des offres des partenaires de distribution, avec une capacité avérée à les mobiliser, à collaborer avec eux et à les accompagner techniquement tout au long du cycle de vente.     • Excellentes compétences en vente consultative, notamment l'écoute active, la structuration des besoins, l'utilisation de tableaux blancs et la capacité de raconter des histoires.     • Excellentes compétences en communication écrite et orale, avec une aisance à présenter des solutions tant à des équipes techniques qu'à des dirigeants.     • Solide connaissance des tendances du secteur du stockage, des produits et stratégies concurrents.     • Sens aigu des affaires et des finances, avec une compréhension des rôles et des priorités des différents interlocuteurs chez le client.     • Solides compétences en gestion de projet, en analyse et en résolution de problèmes.     • Maîtrise des systèmes CRM et des outils de vente, et maîtrise de l'utilisation des médias sociaux et autres canaux pour partager du contenu technique.     • Les certifications dans le secteur du stockage sont grandement appréciées.     Rejoignez-nous et faites votre marque! title: Solutions Architect - Public Sector
AI Technical Architect( Salesforce exp is a must)
description_html: To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.      Job Category  Customer Success    Job Details        About Salesforce     Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.    Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.          The Experience   The AI Technical Architect operates at the intersection of strategy and execution — acting as both a Strategist, shaping the long-term technical vision for AI adoption, and an Orchestrator, coordinating people, systems, and processes to turn that vision into working solutions.  This role is central to designing, scaling, and governing AI and Agentforce-driven architectures across the delivery organization, ensuring technical decisions align with business outcomes and customer value.   What You'll Actually Be Doing      Define and evolve the technical architecture strategy for AI initiatives, aligning with broader business and platform roadmaps.    Evaluate emerging AI technologies (LLMs, agentic frameworks, automation platforms) and recommend where they create differentiated value.    Partner with delivery, product, and engineering leadership to translate business goals into scalable, secure, and maintainable AI architectures.    Establish architectural standards, patterns, and best practices for AI solution design across teams.    Assess technical risk, feasibility, and total cost of ownership for proposed AI initiatives.    Coordinate cross-functional teams (engineering, data, product, delivery) to ensure AI solutions are designed, built, and deployed cohesively.    Serve as the technical glue between strategy and execution — ensuring architecture decisions are implemented consistently across squads and projects.    Facilitate technical governance forums, architecture reviews, and design decision checkpoints.    Drive alignment between multiple parallel AI workstreams, resolving dependencies and technical conflicts.    Mentor and enable technical teams and solution architects on AI-first design principles.    Ship working AI solutions hands-on — prototype, build, and iterate quickly rather than only designing on paper.    Take ideas from concept to production, personally building agents, automations, and integrations when needed to prove value fast.    Champion a bias for action: favor working demos and MVPs over long design documents.    Continuously experiment with new AI tools and techniques, bringing working proofs-of-concept back to the team.    Balance speed of shipping with architectural soundness, ensuring builds are scalable beyond the prototype stage.    Own end-to-end technical quality of AI solutions from design through production readiness.    Define and monitor architecture health metrics (scalability, reliability, cost-efficiency, security posture).    Ensure compliance with data governance, responsible AI, and security standards across all AI implementations.    Provide technical escalation support for complex AI/architecture issues across the portfolio.        You're Our Person If...       10+ years of experience in software/solution architecture, with demonstrated depth in AI/ML or agentic systems architecture.    Proven experience architecting and delivering enterprise-scale AI solutions (e.g., LLM-based systems, automation platforms, Agentforce, or equivalent).    Strong grasp of cloud-native architecture, integration patterns, and platform scalability principles.    Demonstrated ability to operate as both a strategic thinker and hands-on technical orchestrator across multiple teams.    Experience with Salesforce platform architecture is highly valued.    Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills — able to translate technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.        Even Better If...       Salesforce Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or equivalent architecture certification.    Experience leading AI governance, responsible AI, or AI risk frameworks.    Track record of mentoring architects and senior engineers.    Exposure to multi-org, multi-cloud, or complex enterprise topology environments.    Hands-on experience building and deploying AI agents (e.g., Agentforce, custom agent frameworks) in real-world settings.    Practical experience with AI tools such as Gemini, Cursor, and Claude for coding, prototyping, or workflow automation.    Familiarity with prompt engineering, LLM orchestration, and agentic tool-use patterns.    Comfortable working directly in code/config to build and ship — not purely a design-and-document architect.             Unleash Your Potential    When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and     be your best  , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can     do your best  . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.      Accommodations    If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this      Accommodations Request Form     .      Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our      Candidate Privacy Statement      for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.        Posting Statement     Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination.    Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.    Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.
